text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from visiting a shrine 
with Mejiro Dober, who was in a slump...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It was a nice change of pace, but... if 
only that actually solved things...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flump!)

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Waaah~~! It hurts so baaad~~~!

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Boy
text_block_list.text:
"Are you okay?! Let your big bro take a 
look...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh no! I'll go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober rushes over to the young 
siblings and deftly begins administering 
first aid. ...The little girl cheered 
right back up.

text_block_list.name: Elementary School Boy
text_block_list.text: Thank you, miss~!

text_block_list.name: Little Girl
text_block_list.text: Bye-bye, Big Sis~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, bye-bye.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... And off they go. I'm just glad it 
wasn't a serious injury.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I wonder if my little brother and 
sister will be like that before long, 
too."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I haven't seen them much, so it's just a 
vague guess, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...As her big sister, I can't let myself 
trip up in a place like this."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I need to set an example... show them a 
back worth following.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh!! E-Even if you're thinking that, 
you don't have to say it out loud!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, becoming the ideal big sister isn't 
gonna be easy, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Then let's head home. I'm kind of in the 
mood for a run...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Then let's head home. I'm kind of in the 
mood for a run...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Mejiro Dober left the shrine, her 
expression had become remarkably bright 
and clear!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...A big sister, huh... I wonder if I can 
really pull that off..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been performing well lately 
either...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, can I go say one more prayer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from the shrine, Mejiro 
Dober couldn't stop sighing and failed to 
regain her form...
